setting: grandfather's working farm in the countryside; boots, workwear, and clothes suited to animals and soil

sentences.english: One day during summer vacation, my family visited my grandfather's small farm.
sentences.japanese: 夏休みのある日、家族でおじいちゃんの小さな農場を訪ねました。

sentences.english: The country air was very clear.
sentences.japanese: 田舎の空気はとても澄んでいました。

sentences.english: A cow was looking at us with big eyes.
sentences.japanese: 牧場には牛が一頭います。

sentences.english: A pig was moving its nose behind the fence.
A sheep was eating grass with soft white hair.
When we walked toward the hill behind the house, a small rabbit appeared from the bushes.
sentences.japanese: 家の裏の丘のほうへ歩いていくと、茂みから小さなうさぎが飛び出してきました。

sentences.english: For a short moment, our eyes met, and then it quickly turned and ran away.
sentences.japanese: 一瞬、目が合って、そのあとすぐにくるりと向きを変えて逃げていきました。

sentences.english: Above the trees, birds were flying freely, and from time to time, one bird came down low to look at us.
sentences.japanese: 木々の上を、鳥たちが自由に飛んでいて、ときどき一羽が低く降りてきてこちらを見ていました。

sentences.english: Beside a little stream, a small frog jumped.
sentences.japanese: 小さな川のそばでは、かえるがぴょんと跳ねていました。

sentences.english: In the evening, I thought I saw a big bear in the shadow of the far mountain.
sentences.japanese: 夕方、遠くの山の影に大きな熊が見えた気がしました。

sentences.english: “There are many wild animals here,” my grandfather said quietly.
sentences.japanese: 「ここにはたくさんの野生動物がいるんだよ」とおじいちゃんは静かに言いました。

sentences.english: Behind the barn, a horse was eating grass calmly.
sentences.japanese: 納屋のうしろでは、馬がのんびりと草を食べています。

sentences.english: At night, we can hear the small footsteps of a mouse, too.
sentences.japanese: 夜には、ねずみの小さな足音だって聞こえるんです。

sentences.english: In the little stream nearby, we saw small fish swimming.
sentences.japanese: 近くの小川では、小さな魚が泳いでいるのが見えました。

sentences.english: “Not only cats and dogs in our town have lives,” my father quietly added.
sentences.japanese: 「町のねこや犬だけじゃなく、ここにもたくさんの命があるんだよ」と父が静かに付け加えました。
ご覧いただき、ありがとうございました。
